title: Our staple food.
html_source:
Give us this day our daily bread
in Matthew 6:9–13, The Lord’s Prayer

anchor.prefix: ir five tall white hats: H. E. L. Y. S. Wisdom 1932#136Hely's. Y lagging behind drew a chunk of bread from under his foreboard, crammed it into his mouth and munched as he walked.
anchor.suffix: Three bob a day, walking along the gutters, street after street. Just keep skin and bone together, bread and skilly. They are not Boyl: no, M'Glade's men. Doesn't bring in any bus
